description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_DisableExternal', which is a URI filter used within the HTMLPurifier library to disable external resources based on host matching. It includes methods for preparing filter conditions and applying the filtering logic to URIs.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_DisableExternal
classes.description: A URI filter class that disables external links based on host comparison.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the filter by extracting and reversing the host parts of the configured host.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters a given URI, returning true if it's allowed under the filter rules, false otherwise.
